PLAN "12-Week Fat Loss & Glycaemic Control"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Improve fat loss, insulin sensitivity, and glycaemic control"

PHASES
  PHASE "Phase 1: Foundation & Insulin Sensitivity" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Full-Body A + Cardio":
        warmup:
          treadmill_walk 8m
        main straight_sets:
          goblet_squat 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 75 seconds
          lat_pulldown 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 75 seconds
          dumbbell_bench_press 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 75 seconds
          hip_hinge_kettlebell_deadlift 3x10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          dumbbell_split_squat 2x10 each_side rpe 6 rest 75 seconds
          cable_row 2x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          plank 3x30..45 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking_5min_plus_breathing 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 45m "Low-Impact Cardio + Core":
        warmup:
          bike_easy 6m
        main straight_sets:
          elliptical_steady 1x20m rpe 5 rest 0 seconds
          farmer_carry 4x40m rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          side_plank 3x20..30 each_side rpe 6 rest 45 seconds

          calf_hamstring_stretch 5m

NUTRITION
  ENERGY:
    target_calories 1700 kcal
    rationale "Modest 20% deficit from estimated TDEE for fat loss while supporting training and stable glycaemia"
  MACROS:
    protein 1.6 g_per_kg "Aim 110..130g/day spread across 3..4 meals"
    carbs 2.0..2.5 g_per_kg "Focus low-GI, distribute evenly; anchor 25..35g net carbs per meal"
    fat remainder "Prioritize mono- and polyunsaturated fats"
    fiber 28..35 g_per_day "From vegetables, legumes (tolerated), berries, chia/flax"
  CARB_TIMING:
    pre_workout "15..30g low-GI carbs + 20..30g protein 60..90m pre; examples: Greek yogurt with berries; oatmeal with whey; apple + turkey"
    intra_workout "Water; if sessions >75m or symptomatic, consider 10g fast-acting carbs"
    post_workout "20..35g protein + 25..35g carbs; examples: cottage cheese + fruit; tuna wrap on whole-grain; protein shake + banana"
    even_distribution "Avoid large carb loads at dinner; split evenly across day to blunt glucose excursions"
  FOOD_QUALITY:
    emphasize "Vegetables, lean proteins, fish 2x/week, eggs, legumes, whole grains (steel-cut oats, quinoa, barley), nuts/seeds, olive oil"
    limit "Refined sugars, fruit juice, pastries, fried foods, high-sodium processed foods, alcohol (max 3 drinks/week, with food)"
    glycaemic_index "Prefer low-to-moderate GI; pair carbs with protein/fat and fiber"
  HYDRATION:
    target 2.0..2.5 liters_per_day
    electrolytes "Add pinch of salt if sweating heavily; avoid sugar-sweetened beverages"
  MEAL_STRUCTURE:
    meals_per_day 3..4
    example_day_1 "Breakfast: veggie omelet + berries; Lunch: salmon salad with quinoa (3/4 cup cooked); Snack: Greek yogurt + walnuts; Dinner: turkey chili with beans + side salad"
    example_day_2 "Breakfast: steel-cut oats (1/2 cup dry) + whey + chia + blueberries; Lunch: chicken breast, roasted veggies, olive oil; Snack: cottage cheese + cucumber; Dinner: tofu stir-fry with brown rice (3/4 cup cooked)"
  MONITORING:
    glucometer "Check fasting and 2h post-prandial; aim post-prandial <140 mg/dL; note responses to specific foods"
    training_days "Measure pre and 30m post-exercise at least for first 2 weeks to gauge effect; carry fast-acting carbs if symptomatic"
    weight_waist "Track weekly weight and waist; aim 0.4..0.7 kg loss/week"
  METFORMIN_CONSIDERATIONS:
    timing "Take with meals to reduce GI upset; maintain B12 status via periodic labs or 250..500 mcg/day supplement if advised"
  SLEEP_STRESS:
    sleep 7..9 hours
    stress "10m daily walking or breathing after meals improves glycaemia"
  SAFETY:
    hypoglycaemia "Less likely on metformin alone, but if dizziness, shakiness, or confusion occur, consume 15g fast carbs, recheck in 15m"
    foot_care "Use well-fitting footwear; inspect feet daily; avoid barefoot training in gym"
